info.title: varve
info.description: Varve: the server and the varve command line. An event-sourced RDF store with SPARQL 1.1 Query, Update, Graph Store Protocol and a change feed over HTTP.

commands.name: checkpoint
commands.description: Take a checkpoint of a dataset (ADR 0078).

options.name: --allow-endpoint
options.description: An IRI prefix SERVICE may reach from a local dataset; none by default. Repeatable.

options.name: --allow-source
options.description: An IRI prefix LOAD may fetch from for a local dataset; none by default. Repeatable.

options.name: --allow-private-addresses
options.description: Let SERVICE and LOAD reach loopback and private addresses.

options.name: --authority
options.description: The OIDC issuer a server's tokens come from, for a URL.

options.name: --client-id
options.description: The OIDC client: with --client-secret the client credentials flow, alone the device code flow.

options.name: --client-secret
options.description: The client's secret; VARVE_CLIENT_SECRET when absent.

options.name: --scope
options.description: The scope to ask the issuer for.

options.name: --token
options.description: A bearer token obtained elsewhere; VARVE_TOKEN when absent. Nothing is stored.

options.name: --no-store
options.description: Keep no refresh token on disk: for CI and shared machines.

options.name: --credentials
options.description: The credential file; by default under the user's profile.

options.name: --at
options.description: The position to checkpoint; the head by default.

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help and usage information

arguments.name: dataset
arguments.description: A dataset directory, or the URL of a dataset on a server (…/datasets/{name}/).
